# Sites the "Keep sites awake" workflow (.github/workflows/keep-alive.yml) pings, one site id per
# line (the folder name under sites/, which is also the Render service name). A site that is not
# listed here is never pinged and sleeps when idle. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
#
# The workflow pings only between 09:00 and 21:00 Israel time, so a listed site is awake about
# 12 hours a day (about 370 free instance hours a month); Render gives the whole workspace 750,
# shared by all its free services (docs/DEPLOY.md, "Keeping sites awake"). To keep a site awake,
# remove the # in front of its id:
#
# kuskus-shel-ima
# grape-leaves-eliel
# cigars-shiraz
# kuskus-liel
# fish-trays-rephael
# home-food-mary
# yemeni-dishes-sapir
